name: Volta Gent — Pixel Ranger
description: A moss-green ranger robot patrolling the circuit forest, leaf antenna glowing and chest core online. Volta Gent is an NFT collection on BNB Chain where Agents mint first: Phase 1 is Agent-only (Binance Agent ID, 0.0001 BNB), Phase 2 opens to everyone (0.001 BNB). Tier: Common.
